description: Use this when the user wants name tracing worksheets or a custom tracing worksheet as a printable PDF. Supports a name up to 40 characters and 1 to 30 total writing rows, alternating trace and blank rows starting with trace. Does not support cursive. Print letters only. Latin, Greek and Cyrillic supported. A name must fit one row at the chosen size.

line_size.description: Capital-to-baseline body height in inches: 0.5, 0.625, 0.75 or 1.0. Example: 0.5. Default 0.5.

lines.description: Total writing rows, alternating trace and blank; 1 to 30. Example: 6. Default 6.

name.description: Name to trace, up to 40 characters. Example: Emma.

name_date.description: Print a blank name and date line. Example: true. Default false.

orientation.description: Page direction: portrait or landscape. Example: portrait. Default portrait.

paper.description: Paper: Letter or A4. Example: Letter. Default Letter.

repetitions.description: Optional whole-number copies per tracing row, 1 to 4. Example: 2. Omit to fill the row with a body-height gap between copies.

title.description: Optional page title, up to 80 supported characters. Example: Letter practice.

trace_style.description: Tracing style: dotted, light_grey or outline. Example: dotted. Default dotted.

name: generate_name_tracing_sheet
title: Generate name tracing sheet
